{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-load and clean data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')
trial_df.columns = ['patient_id', 'sample_seq', 'site', 'arm', 'severity', 'age', 'sex', 'assay_batch', 'biomarker_baseline', 'biomarker_final', 'responded']

# Check severity distribution
severity_counts = trial_df['severity'].value_counts()
print(f'Severity distribution:\n{severity_counts}')

# Check if any patients have severe severity
severe_patients = trial_df[trial_df['severity'] == 'severe']
print(f'Number of patients with severe severity: {len(severe_patients)}')

# Check baseline biomarker for severe patients
if len(severe_patients) > 0:
    severe_biomarker = severe_patients['biomarker_baseline'].mean()
    print(f'Mean baseline biomarker value among severe patients: {severe_biomarker}')
else:
    print('No patients in severe severity group.')

# Check for non-positive baseline biomarker values in severe group
if len(severe_patients) > 0:
    non_positive = severe_patients[severe_patients['biomarker_baseline'] <= 0]
    print(f'Number of non-positive baseline biomarker values in severe group: {len(non_positive)}')
else:
    print('No patients in severe severity group.')"}
